dbqueries.dbquery: insert into tp_last_viewed (entity_id, entity_type, entity_date_viewed, entity_viewed_by) values (?, ?, now(), ?)

SELECT entity_id, entity_type, CASE WHEN entity_type=? THEN (SELECT applicant_name FROM tp_applicants WHERE applicant_id=tplv.entity_id) ELSE (SELECT @@ FROM tp_positions WHERE position_id=tplv.entity_id) END AS description, last_viewed FROM ( SELECT entity_id , entity_type , max(entity_date_viewed) as last_viewed FROM tp_last_viewed WHERE entity_viewed_by=? @@ GROUP BY entity_id , entity_type ORDER BY last_viewed desc LIMIT 0, 7 ) AS tplv

SELECT entity_id ,tps.@@ as description,entity_type , max(entity_date_viewed) as last_viewed FROM tp_last_viewed tlv, tp_positions tps WHERE tps.position_id = tlv.entity_id and entity_viewed_by=? AND entity_type=? GROUP BY entity_id , entity_type ORDER BY last_viewed desc LIMIT 0, 5
